Class RmiServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.rmi.server.RmiServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServerRmi, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualServerRmi
RMI server exposed to clients; deserializes incoming JSON strings into DTO objects so the core Server can process them. Keeps a registry of RmiClientAdapter instances that wrap each VirtualViewRmi stub into a VirtualView capable of receiving DTOs

  • Constructor Details

    • RmiServer

      public RmiServer(String serverName, int port, Server mainServer) throws RemoteException
      Creates an RMI server stub exported on the given port. WARNING: java.rmi.server.hostname must be set before calling this method.
      Parameters:
      serverName - the registry binding name
      port - the RMI registry port; also used to export this object
      mainServer - the core server to delegate requests to
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the RMI runtime fails to export this object

      public void start() throws RemoteException
      Starts the RMI registry and binds this server on server name. WARNING: java.rmi.server.hostname must be set before calling this method (and before constructing this object), as the IP is captured at export time
